objective: Enable one Agent Team to create, browse, inspect, and independently approve multiple missions in the Web UI, with each mission owning its own plan revision and lifecycle, and verify the result through the project's canonical installer against the supplied full DSH checkout.
non_goals: Do not redesign teammate spawning, model routing, or non-Web Agent Team surfaces.
Do not activate GAT in the user's live Web profile or restart the current DSH Web server.

Do not modify unrelated dirty files in the supplied DSH checkout; external effects are limited to the dedicated verify-gat-install-0.1.5-rc.2 worktree and Git worktrees created by the canonical verifier.

requirements.acceptance: The Team core exposes durable mission records with stable id, title, objective, status (draft, approved, active, completed), revision, and per-mission approval; each mission owns an independent plan/task set and approval does not approve another mission.
Authorized core operations can create a mission, list missions, read one mission detail, and approve the exact current revision with stale-revision and unauthorized-operation rejection evidence.
The Web UI offers Add Mission and renders a refreshable mission list with each mission's title, status, revision, and approval state.
Selecting a mission opens its detail and an approval control approves only the displayed mission revision, showing success and conflict/error states without changing other missions.

The canonical installer verifier against the supplied full DSH checkout passes focused core/Web tests, the full DSH build, built-library smoke, and assembled Web dashboard smoke; integration evidence binds results to accepted source bytes.

tasks.title: Confirm the focused test and build entrypoints
tasks.deliverable: wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/toolchain.md records the available Vitest entrypoint and the discovered source-workspace tsconfig limitation that revision 2 resolves through canonical installed-worktree verification.

criteria: Existing accepted attempt-discover-001 remains valid because its input and output hashes match revision 2 sources.

stop_conditions: Stop if the accepted toolchain evidence bytes no longer match the revision 2 source hash.

tasks.title: Complete and review durable multi-mission core state
tasks.deliverable: Core Team service, types, projection, journal events, mission board, and focused tests implement independent mission records, mission-owned task plans, create/list/detail, exact-revision approval, durable replay, and conflict handling; an independent static review clears the API seam for Web work while runtime behavior remains gated by integration-verification.

evidence: Inspect mission types, event schemas, projection replay, service authorization, Remote result mapping, and focused tests against mission-domain and mission-mutations.
Confirm existing global Team task behavior is preserved and identify any correctness issue before Web implementation begins.

criteria: Independent reviewer finds no blocking structural or authorization defect in the core mission API and tests.
Runtime functionality is explicitly deferred to integration-verification and is not claimed from static review alone.

stop_conditions: Stop if mission isolation requires an unapproved migration to unrelated Session or provider storage.
Stop if the reviewer finds a defect that cannot be repaired within the one remaining core attempt.
Stop if core changes require Web-only assumptions absent from public service types.

tasks.title: Add and review Web mission management flows
tasks.deliverable: Web Team panel and Remote mount expose Add Mission, mission list, selected mission detail, independent approval controls, refresh behavior, localization, and client tests; an independent static review checks the requested UI and error-state contracts before installed verification.

evidence: Inspect Add Mission, mission list, selected detail, exact-revision approval, refresh/conflict/error behavior, localization, and client tests against mission-web-list and mission-web-detail-approval.
Confirm legacy roster and shared-task flows remain represented in the component and tests.

criteria: Independent reviewer finds no blocking UI contract or Remote wiring defect.
Runtime UI functionality is explicitly deferred to integration-verification and is not claimed from static review alone.

stop_conditions: Stop if the Remote client contract cannot carry mission identity without a core API repair.
Stop if the requested interactions require unrelated apps/web shell changes.
Stop after two failed Web attempts without a new diagnosis.

tasks.title: Package and verify multi-mission GAT in full DSH
tasks.deliverable: Updated compatibility artifacts plus wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/integration.md record rollback of the prior dedicated verification install, deterministic regeneration, installation of current source, and the canonical verifier result against the supplied full DSH checkout, with hashes and remaining limitations.

criteria: All four declared commands succeed exactly once for the current attempt.
The canonical verifier passes focused core/Web tests, full build, built-library smoke, and assembled Web dashboard smoke on current installed bytes.
integration.md records actual outcomes and hashes without claiming activation in the live Web profile.

stop_conditions: Stop if rollback detects modified installed files or unrelated target changes.
Stop if deterministic compatibility generation touches paths outside compatibility/dsh-0.1.5-rc.2.
Stop if the canonical verifier changes paths outside its manifest allowlist or any required verification stage fails.

tasks.title: Review the multi-mission acceptance conclusion
tasks.deliverable: wbs-runs/multi-mission-web-ui/final-report.md maps each requirement to accepted implementation, review, and canonical verification evidence, records limitations, and states whether the human should accept the mission outcome.

evidence: Compare final-report.md with integration.md, independent task reviews, and accepted source/compatibility hashes.
Confirm each requirement has observable evidence and no claim implies live-profile activation or an unperformed action.

criteria: The human accepts the exact reviewed final report for revision 3, or records a hold/rejection with the missing evidence.

stop_conditions: A human hold, rejected requirement, or missing provenance leaves final acceptance open.
